About

About

Amrita Bose is a doctoral researcher in cryptography and security. At present, her Ph.D. research focuses on identifying and mitigating security vulnerabilities in the healthcare domain, particularly emphasizing implantable and wearable medical devices and the associated environment.

During her Master's (M.S.) at IIT Kharagpur, she worked extensively in the area of cryptanalysis using machine learning techniques. Prior to starting her academic journey at IIT Kharagpur, she gained valuable industry experience working as an Application Developer (Associate IT Consultant at ITC Infotech).
